dedupe_keys.name: chemical industrial parks along the yangtze river 10 m map 2021

description: This figshare dataset maps chemical industrial parks within 5 km of the Yangtze River in China at 10 m resolution for 2021. The authors trained a random forest classifier with active learning on many annotated samples of chemical-park and non-park areas, using Sentinel-2 imagery with spectral and texture features plus physical characteristics of chemical parks identified from points of interest, and ran the prediction in partitions on Google Earth Engine. Their validation gives an accuracy of 80 percent, and they describe it as the first 10 m distribution map of chemical parks along the river. The file is a single RAR archive of about 380 KB (version 3, 5 June 2024), free under CC BY 4.0. Authors are Wenming Song, Mingxing Chen and Zhipeng Tang. Caveats: the map is a classification with about one fifth error, it covers only a 5 km riverside band and one year, and the raster or vector format inside the archive is not stated on the page read. For simulation it locates hazardous chemical clusters next to a major river, for flood and spill exposure analysis and for scenarios where a flood or accident at a park disrupts water intakes, shipping and downstream users. Related catalogue records include the processed C-RSM data on climate-triggered safety margins of riverine chemical parks and the European Industrial Emissions Portal.
